## API at a glance

| Method | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `unlock_keystore` | `unlock_keystore(password: tstr) -> tstr` | Open (create-if-absent) the keystore at the instance persistence path and hold the session password in memory (needed to seal credentials on register and unseal them on generate_proof). |
| `lock_keystore` | `lock_keystore() -> tstr` | Drop the session password (zeroized). |
| `register_membership` | `register_membership(registry_id: tstr, rln_identifier_hex: tstr, options_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Spec register(scope, options) — named register_membership on this wire ("register" is a C/C++ keyword; generated clients could not carry the spec spelling). |
| `get_membership_state` | `get_membership_state(registry_id: tstr, rln_identifier_hex: tstr) -> tstr` | Spec get_membership_state(scope). |
| `get_memberships` | `get_memberships(registry_id: tstr) -> tstr` | Spec get_memberships(): all locally managed memberships for the registry, ANY state including pending and failed (filtering usable ones is select's job); public view. |
| `select_membership` | `select_membership(registry_id: tstr, rln_identifier_hex: tstr, selector_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Spec select(). |
| `get_merkle_proof` | `get_merkle_proof(registry_id: tstr, leaf_index: int) -> tstr` | Provider passthrough. |
| `get_valid_roots` | `get_valid_roots(registry_id: tstr) -> tstr` | Provider passthrough. |
| `generate_proof` | `generate_proof(registry_id: tstr, rln_identifier_hex: tstr, signal_hex: tstr, timestamp: tstr) -> result` | Spec generate_proof(scope, signal, timestamp). |
| `validate_proof` | `validate_proof(registry_id: tstr, rln_identifier_hex: tstr, signal_hex: tstr, timestamp: tstr, proof_json: tstr) -> result` | Spec validate_proof(scope, signal, timestamp, proof). |
| `get_epoch_quota` | `get_epoch_quota(registry_id: tstr, rln_identifier_hex: tstr, timestamp: tstr) -> result` | Spec get_epoch_quota(scope, timestamp): the epoch of the supplied timestamp, the scope's membership rate limit, and the budget still unspent in that epoch — for consumer-side send scheduling (rolling a metering window… |
| `get_registry_parameters` | `get_registry_parameters(registry_id: tstr, rln_identifier_hex: tstr) -> result` | Registry parameters read (spec's optional extension): the registry-declared parameters that bound registration, plus the module's configured epoch window — {"epoch_size_sec","max_epoch_gap","max_rate_limit", "min_rate… |
| `provision_wallet_home` | `provision_wallet_home(options_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Provision a wallet-home under this module's persistence dir. |
| `unlock_keystore_auto` | `unlock_keystore_auto() -> tstr` | Auto-unlock: module-owned password custody, ALL platforms. |
| `remember_keystore_password` | `remember_keystore_password() -> tstr` | Persist the CURRENT session password to the OS keychain so the next unlock_keystore_auto succeeds silently — the manual-to-auto migration hook (the plaintext never re-crosses the wire; it is read module-side). |
| `start` | `start(config_json: tstr) -> result` | Spec start(). |
| `stop` | `stop() -> result` | Spec stop(). |
